p: physicians to embalm his father: He means those who embalmed the dead and buried them.
threescore and ten days: They were more excessive in lamenting than the faithful.
as he made thee swear: Even the infidels would have oaths carried out.
Joseph will peradventure hate us: An evil conscience is never fully at rest.
God of thy father: Meaning, that they who have one God should be joined in most sure love.
God: Who by the good success seems to remit it, and therefore it should not be revenged by me.
hundred and ten years: Who, even though he ruled in Egypt about eighty years, yet was joined with the church of God in faith and religion.
God will surely visit you: He speaks this by the spirit of prophecy, exhorting his brethren to have full trust in God's promise for their deliverance.
